references.text: David also uses imagery and parables to convey deeper truths, just as Jesus did.
Isaiah is asked to speak to the people in riddles, which mirrors Jesus' use of parables to communicate his message.
Proverbs introduces wisdom teaching through parables, paralleling how Jesus taught.
This verse in Matthew confirms that Jesus used parables to teach the people, which directly corresponds with Mark 4:2.
Luke also mentions that Jesus explained the mysteries of God's kingdom through parables, which aligns with the teaching method described in Mark 4:2.
